simple.summary: אֲבוֹי (ʼăbôwy) means want First listed occurrence: Prov 23 29.

definitions.full: H17. aboy אֲבוֺי interjection exclamation of pain, Oh! Prov 23:29 (|| אוֺי woe! ). Probably akin to Syriac alas . . . ! PS 53 (AW Ges less probably as a substantive need from אָבָה , compare אֶבְיוֺן ). אבח (Dl BD Ez. x; Prov 75 compare Assyrian [ abâµu ], torment , but dubious)
